description: Export the document and check the rendered result.

identity.goal: Complete the export artwork use case of vectorcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the vectorcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `vectorcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced vectorcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `vectorcraft_inspect_document`, `vectorcraft_export`, `vectorcraft_render_preview`, `vectorcraft_screenshot`. Steps: (1) Inspect the artboards. (2) Export the document. (3) Render a preview to verify. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace vectorcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
